question: Is the data in CoVoST annotated for dialect?
title: CoVoST: A Diverse Multilingual Speech-To-Text Translation Corpus
answer_rationale: Text 2 states that 'Most of the sentences (transcripts) in CoVoST are covered by multiple speakers with potentially different accents, resulting in a rich diversity in the speeches.' This implies that the data includes variations in accents, which can be interpreted as dialectal variation.
